changelog: 4.0.0: preserve v1-v3 and historical reports; separate ready data from system evaluation results.
65 RAG QA cases: 94 literal source facts, atomic evidence bindings, explicit absence scopes, corrected task boundaries; no mandatory human evaluator.
85 functional scenarios retain their own inputs and checks; one latest-learning contract remains blocked. Controlled model fixtures do not measure model decision quality.
Report source validation, retrieval performance, generation and semantic grading separately. Never infer task success from annotation membership.
Persist complete ranked results and production retrieval stages, generated answers and automatic judge reasons when those stages execute. Keep failures visible.
